edits.before: Zoe owns level 1: her Paddle Star Q, especially charged over terrain or minions, hits like a truck and out-ranges you, and her Spell Thief W recycles your summoners and jungle items into extra bombs. Don't step into a charged Q line early -- one hit plus a bubble follow-up is a huge chunk. At 2, though, the lane starts leaning your way: you can shove with Wild Cards and your roam threat begins to pressure a champion with no real mobility beyond a short Portal Hop. Farm safely, dodge the Q angle, and keep your HP high enough that her burst can't set up a kill.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are a skill check on her Sleepy Trouble Bubble E -- that's the setup for all her damage, so if you dodge the bubble she has almost no kill pressure, and if you get hit you eat a full charged Q into an empowered auto. Keep minions between you and her E line, push with Blue Card, and hold Yellow Card for when she's used her bubble. At 6 the matchup swings to you: Destiny is ideal against an immobile burst mage -- shove and Gate to a gank or sidelane, and make her pay for having no escape. Her Portal Hop only dodges skillshots; it doesn't save her from a global collapse.
